# noozle_query_outlet_link (Resource)

Manages one query-to-outlet association for a pre-existing Noozle outlet.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `outlet_id` (Number) Identifier of the pre-existing outlet.
- `query_id` (Number) Identifier of the query to associate with the outlet.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in `<outlet_id>:<query_id>` format.
